name: Perspective Print Depicting Wan-Nian Qiao Bridge in Suzhou
summary: European Jesuit artists working at the Chinese imperial court in the 17th and 18th centuries played an important role in introducing western painting styles to China. Interest in European perspective techniques spread to Suzhou in eastern China, a centre for the production of woodblock prints to cel
